convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iRSI, iStochastic). Entry/exit rules are straightforward conditionals. Position sizing uses a simple risk-percent formula with anti-martingale loss counting. Standard CTrade library for execution. No custom indicators or external trading logic libraries.

derived_values.used_by: Position sizing for both Buy and Sell

other_exits: Margin-based emergency close: if account profit<0 and abs(profit)>=margin*MaximumRisk, close all positions
RSI+Stochastic signal close for BUY: RSI>60 AND Stoch_15_8_8_SIGNAL falling (signal[0]<signal[1]) AND Stoch_15_8_8_SIGNAL>70
RSI+Stochastic signal close for SELL: RSI<40 AND Stoch_15_8_8_SIGNAL rising (signal[0]>signal[1]) AND Stoch_15_8_8_SIGNAL<30

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot = FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000.0. If DecreaseFactor>0, count consecutive losses in last 24h and reduce: lot = lot - lot*losses/DecreaseFactor. Minimum lot = 0.1. Input Lots=0.1 is used as fallback minimum.

custom_logic_notes: Hedging account required (INIT_FAILED if not hedging mode). New bar guard uses iTickVolume(0)>1 check (only trades on first tick of bar). RSI indicator handle created with period=3 and PRICE_MEDIAN, but input parameter PeriodRSI=4 is declared yet never used - likely a bug. Stochastic 10_3_3 used only as a spread/gap filter (main-signal divergence >5 points required for entry). Close logic uses Stoch 15_8_8 signal line comparisons between bar[0] and bar[1] for direction confirmation.
python_conversion_notes: Three built-in indicators to replicate: Stochastic(15,8,8,SMA,LowHigh), Stochastic(10,3,3,SMA,LowHigh), RSI(3,Median). New-bar guard via tick volume check translates to bar-boundary detection. Position sizing has anti-martingale lot reduction based on consecutive losses in past 24h - requires trade history lookup. No SL/TP on orders - exits are purely signal-based and margin-based. Close conditions involve comparing indicator values between current and previous bar (signal line momentum). The PeriodRSI input (4) is unused; RSI is hardcoded to period=3 with PRICE_MEDIAN. Digit adjustment code exists in OnInit but has no practical effect since SL/TP are 0.
